summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc. (formerly Chijet Motor Company) filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting on September 3, 2026. Shareholders will vote on a 160-for-1 share consolidation, an authorized share capital increase, and a share capital reduction/reorganization. The proposals are routine corporate actions aimed at adjusting share structure and capital accounts, typical for maintaining Nasdaq listing standards. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or strategic transaction is involved. The filing is a meeting notice with ordinary resolutions, not a special situation.
